text:
jamie: Hey! second day and I'm blocked on a couple of things — Okta is forcing me to enroll a passkey but my YubiKey (5C) isn't being detected on my Mac (Ventura). 1Password invite says \"no seats available\" for my work email, and I can't SSH into my devbox (Permission denied (publickey)). Who do I ping?

alex: Welcome! :wave: Ping @it-help first. For the passkey flow, sometimes macOS needs a firmware update or a different adapter. Do you see a \"platform authenticator\" prompt or an option to use a security key?

maria: Hi Jamie — can you check System Information > USB to see if the YubiKey shows up? Also which USB-C adapter/dongle are you using? Some hubs don't expose the key correctly.

jamie: I tried two adapters (Anker hub + straight USB-C), nothing shows. System Info doesn't list YubiKey. I ran yubikey-manager but it errors: \"No YubiKey found\".

samir: I'll open a ticket and help triage. Can you run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and paste the output? Also what's the YubiKey model exactly (5C, 5Ci, etc) and serial? If the YubiKey isn't enumerating it's likely a USB/hub issue or mac OS permissions.

jamie: Output pasted (small excerpt):
```
Apple USB 3.1 Bus:
  Host Controller Driver: AppleUSBXHCI
  YubiKey 5C:
    Product ID: 0x0127
    Vendor ID: 0x1050
    Version: 1.00
```
But yubikey-manager still errors.

samir: OK the device shows at OS level which is good. Try: `brew reinstall ykman` then `ykman info`. Also check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Input Monitoring / USB Accessories prompts — approve if you saw any. If still fails, try on an iPhone to enroll a passkey as a temporary workaround (Okta supports passkeys via platform authenticators on iOS).

alex: For the 1Password seat, are you signed up with jamie@personalmail.com or jamie@redwood.com? If it's to personal, we need people-ops to resend to corporate email. @people-ops usually handles seat allocation.

jamie: Invite was sent to jamie.personal@gmail — oops. Can someone resend to jamie@redwood.com?

it-bot: Ticket IT-2476 created by samir: \"Okta passkey YubiKey not enumerating + 1Password seat resend\" — link: https://tickets.internal/IT-2476

maria: Re: SSH: generate a fresh key locally and add the public key to your profile. Commands:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"jamie@redwood.com\"
eval \"$(ssh-agent -s)\"
ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Then drop the pub key here and I'll add it to the devbox. If you get \"Permission denied\" after that we'll check the server-side authorized_keys.

jamie: Generated key and pasted pubkey. SSH still failing: `Permission denied (publickey)`.

samir: I can provision a temporary pair on the server side and drop you a one-time key. Also checking Okta provisioning: if passkey flow fails, you can register the YubiKey as a U2F/security key in Okta (fallback) — go to Security Methods > Add security key.

alex: For the 1Password seat I've notified @people-ops and asked them to resend. Should be quick.

samir: Update: I repro'd the ykman error on a test Mac with similar OS — `ykman info` fails if the yubikey-agent daemon isn't permitted. Try `brew services restart ykman` or run `sudo ykman info` to see if it's a permissions issue. If you prefer, bring the YubiKey to my desk and I'll test with a known-good adapter. I'll also push a temp SSH key to your account now (expect DM).

jamie: Thanks all — appreciate the fast help! I'll try the sudo command and then swing by your desk @samir if still broken.

it-bot: Ticket IT-2476 updated: samir assigned, status = In Progress

alex: Also FYI — if you need immediate access to docs, use the read-only google share link I just DM'd.

jamie: Got the DM and the temp SSH creds worked. 1Password invite resent to jamie@redwood.com, accepted. Will follow up after I test passkey registration on iPhone.

samir: Closing loop: left a note in IT-2476 with steps taken. If the YubiKey still doesn't register we'll escalate to Yubico support.

jamie: All unblocked for now, thanks everyone :tada:
